description: Record task context or deliver a live prompt/reply to another promptable workspace agent.

agent_id.description: Usually omit — Concord derives your identity from your session. Pass only the id your client told you (Codex); a session Concord can see always wins.

delivery_mode.description: Live delivery mode; steer is the only mode in v1

idempotency_key.description: Required for prompt and reply; makes delivery safe to retry

operation.description: Defaults to record; prompt and reply deliver live inter-agent messages

task_id.description: Required for record; optional context for prompts

workspace_id.description: Workspace id returned by a Concord operation. Omit to use the automatically resolved repository workspace.

name: update_work
title: Update work
